        Accordions

        What does a day trip include?
        The transfer from the hotel, the boat, lunch, snorkelling gear and the park fee.
        Can I cancel a booking?
        Free of charge up to 24 hours before the start; later, half the price is kept.
        Are children welcome?
        From four years old; under four they travel free.
        Pickup
        07:30 at the pier, 07:00 from the hotels of Chaweng.
        What to bring
        Swimwear, a towel and a sunscreen that spares the reef.
        Prices
        Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.

                Prose

                A day at Ang Thong

                The boat leaves the pier at eight and is back before sunset. Lunch is on the beach, and the water is calm from December to April.

                What to bring

                • Shoes for the climb to the lookout
                • A hat and water
                • Cash for the park fee

                The emerald lake is a short walk from the beach.

                The booking code is ANG-0812; show it at the pier.

                Route of the day

                Pick-up at the hotel at 7:30, the pier at 8:15, Ang Thong at 9:30; snorkeling, the emerald lake, lunch on the boat, back by 17:00.

                Plan The boat Lunch Back

                Plan

                Pick-up at the hotel at 7:30, the pier at 8:15. The crew hands out life vests and snorkels before the boat leaves the bay.

                The boat

                A speedboat for 30 guests with shade and a toilet; the ride to the park takes an hour across open water.

                Lunch

                Thai lunch on a beach of the park: rice, green curry, fruit and water; vegetarian on request.

                Back

                The boat leaves the park at 15:30 and reaches the pier by 17:00; the transfer brings everyone back to the hotel.
